method: Game-level offense residual against pregame opponent allowed profile; defensive game residual = negative of opponent offense residual for the same metric. Equal offense/defense overall weight.
fcs_policy: FCS games excluded in this first combined comparison. No additional credit for FCS; separate below-expectation penalty calibration is still required.
comparison_warning: These ranks reflect only 13 overlapping advanced metrics with equal averaging, are not a direct apples-to-apples test of all v15 metrics or v15 overall standard deviation. Game scores are in 2025 validation residual-SD units.
